entries.why: APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #565 (#556 follow-up): two tightenings. Client event updates may not change startDate, endDate, timeZone, recurrence or status (server routes own them); client-created registrations may not carry seat, payment, run, refund or cancellation fields. No new access. Covered by tests/rules/events-registrations.rules.test.ts.
